properties.title: Verified property listings
properties.description: Browse apartments, houses, land, and commercial property across Syria. Every listing shows its verification status — no hidden risk.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.description: Curated articles on legal procedures, banking, fraud risks, and neighborhood guides. Every claim is sourced — no rumors, no shortcuts.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Ask questions in Arabic, German, or English. Get answers grounded in real Syrian law — and clear admissions when the AI doesn't know.

trust.heading: We are honest about what is hard
trust.description: Buying property in Syria today is not simple. Records were falsified during the previous regime. Foreign ownership requires Interior Ministry approval. Banking is still being rebuilt. A specialized property court opens in 2026. We do not hide these realities — we help you navigate them.

footerCta.heading: Ready to start?
footerCta.description: Browse listings, search the knowledge base, or ask the AI assistant your first question.
